title: Zingy Keto Zucchini Fritters
description: A keto twist on traditional fritters, using zing and zucchini, perfect for a low-carb diet.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine grated zucchini, zing, diced tomato, parmesan cheese, coconut flour, eggs, and crumbed cottage cheese.
3. Mix well until a thick batter forms.
4. Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
5. Drop the batter by tablespoonfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
6. Flatten each fritter slightly with a spatula.
7. Cook for 3-4 minutes or until the edges start to brown.
8. Flip the fritters and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes or until golden brown.
9. Transfer the fritters to a baking sheet.
10. Drizzle melted olive oil over the fritters.
11. Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes or until crispy and golden.
